positioning: Turn your grant budget, accounting export, program updates, and funder form into a review-ready report draft—without replacing your accounting system.
primaryAudience: U.S. nonprofit finance teams responsible for recurring post-award grant reporting
buyers: Vice president of finance and administration

painThemes.spreadsheet_bridge: Accounting data and grant requirements are repeatedly rebuilt in Excel.
painThemes.funder_mapping: GL categories do not cleanly match each funder's approved budget lines.
painThemes.fragmented_handoff: Finance, program, and grants teams assemble different parts of the same report in separate tools.
painThemes.missing_evidence: Receipts, explanations, approvals, and program facts are chased late in the reporting process.
painThemes.manual_coding: Transaction coding and allocation require judgment and are concentrated in a few people.
painThemes.funder_format: Teams must translate approved accounting data into different funder templates.
painThemes.price_sensitivity: Nonprofits prefer lightweight tools that work with existing systems and avoid complex implementation.

valuePillars: Collect only the program information that is missing
Catch contradictions, unsupported statements, and missing evidence earlier
Keep professional review and approval in the finance team's hands

required: Nonprofit organization or a finance firm serving nonprofits
Role touches finance, grants, compliance, or post-award reporting
Current role and organization verified by an official source
discoveryQuestions: How many active grants require financial or narrative reports?
Which accounting system and spreadsheets are used today?
Who maps GL activity to funder budget categories?
Where are program updates and supporting documents collected?
Which step causes the most rework before a report is approved?
disqualifiers: Grant discovery or proposal writing is the only need
Seeking autonomous submission or replacement accounting software

offer.name: Historical Report Assessment
offer.discount: eligible questionnaire participants who become new customers can receive 10% off their first three monthly payments
